combo_box.name: scope_layout
combo_box.tool_tip: How many scopes to show at once. Right-click any pane to choose which scope it shows: a histogram says how much of the frame sits at each brightness, a waveform or parade says where in the frame it is, and a vectorscope says what colour, on the same plane the colour wheels edit. Showing several costs nothing to measure -- every scope is computed from the same sample whether or not it is on screen.

check_box.label: Log scale
check_box.tool_tip: Compress tall bins so the rest of the distribution stays readable. A histogram is spiky; on a linear scale one dominant tone flattens everything else onto the axis.
check_box.name: scope_log

text.name: scope_clipping
text.tool_tip: Share of sampled pixels sitting exactly on black or exactly on white in their worst channel. Measured from a point sample of the frame, so it estimates the true share rather than counting every pixel. Point at the world and this reads the value under the cursor instead.
